title: Schedule coverage checker
description: Objective: generate and verify the complete CORE invariant/scenario schedule universe, reachable transitions, race pairs, and fault boundaries. Deliverable: a headless checker plus versioned ScheduleCoverageManifest. NOT in scope: benchmark competitor claims. Hard dependencies: frozen v1 reducers and commands. Owned paths: packages/testkit/src/schedule/** and tests/property/schedule/**. Verification: pnpm test:property.
definitionOfDone: Every CORE-I1 through CORE-I22 and CORE-S1 through CORE-S14 obligation maps to canonical schedules and frozen minima.
Missing, duplicate, unreachable, or unhit obligations yield FAIL or UNKNOWN, never PASS.
Property gate passes with a complete manifest.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red — tests/property/schedule/schedule-checker.test.ts (unit layer against SYNTHETIC universes; tests/ is untypechecked — no tsconfig covers it and vitest esbuild strips types — so every gate tooth must be a RUNTIME assertion, never a type-level one). Exercise every fail-closed path of checkScheduleCoverage with synthetic fixtures: (1) missing obligation mapping -> FAIL SCHEDULE_OBLIGATION_UNMAPPED; (2) duplicate canonical schedule identity -> FAIL SCHEDULE_IDENTITY_DUPLICATE; (3) schedule referencing a transition absent from the injected tables -> FAIL SCHEDULE_TRANSITION_UNREACHABLE; (4) DERIVED-UNIVERSE reverse completeness: a transition/race-pair derived from the injected tables that NO schedule references -> FAIL SCHEDULE_UNIVERSE_UNCOVERED (this is the 'generate' direction — design 1233: authors cannot shrink the source-derived universe); (5) obligation whose schedules reference un-landed aggregates or lack hit evidence -> UNKNOWN with a stable reason code naming the missing aggregate/evidence class (SCHEDULE_AGGREGATE_UNLANDED / SCHEDULE_EVIDENCE_ABSENT) — auditable UNKNOWN, never PASS; (6) stratum minima table violation -> FAIL SCHEDULE_STRATUM_MINIMUM_UNMET; (7) PASS requires reachable + hit-evidence refs — synthetic case proving no silent PASS. Canonicalization property tests (seeded xorshift32, no fast-check): permuting IDs/timestamps/seeds/key order yields byte-identical canonical form + identical sha256 identity; canonicalization is idempotent; distinct semantic content yields distinct identity. Run `pnpm exec vitest run tests/property/schedule` — confirm RED (modules absent).

implementationPlan.description: Green — packages/testkit/src/schedule/schedule-checker.ts (target <=250, split before 400). checkScheduleCoverage({obligations, universe, transitionTables, hitEvidence}) -> deep-frozen ScheduleCoverageManifest. GENERATION (the task's 'generate' verb, design 1233): from the INJECTED transition tables (data parameters — testkit deps stay @moe/contracts only, no @moe/core dependency), mechanically derive (a) the reachable-edge universe: every {aggregate, fromState, commandKind, toState} in the tables; (b) the two-event race-pair universe: every unordered pair of DISTINCT commands legal in the same fromState of the same aggregate. Verify BOTH directions: forward — every schedule transitionRef/racePairRef exists in the derived universe (else FAIL SCHEDULE_TRANSITION_UNREACHABLE); reverse — every derived edge and race pair is referenced by >=1 schedule (else FAIL SCHEDULE_UNIVERSE_UNCOVERED; authors cannot shrink the derived universe). Completeness: all 36 obligations mapped with stratum minima met (per-stratum table). Verdict computation per obligation: FAIL on any missing/duplicate/unreachable/uncovered/minima violation; UNKNOWN with auditable reason code when schedules reference un-landed aggregates (aggregate absent from injected tables) or hit evidence is absent; PASS ONLY when mapped + reachable + evidence refs present. Determinism: sorted iteration everywhere, no Date/random; manifest digest = sha256 of canonical serialization. All step-1 synthetic tests green.

implementationPlan.note:
THE FIX (QA items 1 and 2). ABSTRACT_EDGE is deleted; nothing is referenced abstractly any more.

Derivation source-read, not guessed — every new edge is transcribed from the landed reducer, including the to-state the transition table itself does not carry:
- PLANNING_RUN, 24 edges: create_draft GENESIS->DRAFT; ready DRAFT->READY; claim READY->PLANNING and PLANNING->PLANNING (resume branch); release/recover_absent PLANNING->PLANNING; propose PLANNING->PLANNING, PLANNING->SUBMISSION_DRAINING (live planner effect) and SUBMISSION_DRAINING->SUBMISSION_DRAINING (idempotent replay); finalize_submission PLANNING/SUBMISSION_DRAINING -> PLAN_REVIEW (seal) or REJECTED (refusal, rejectRun); plan.approve PLAN_REVIEW->APPROVED and APPROVED->APPROVED; plan.revise PLAN_REVIEW->REJECTED; graph.approve PLAN_REVIEW->ACTIVATED (compound J1) and APPROVED->ACTIVATED; goal.cancel from all six live states -> CANCELLED.
- GRAPH_REVISION, 8 edges: create GENESIS->DRAFT; submit DRAFT->PENDING_APPROVAL; graph.approve PENDING_APPROVAL->APPROVED, PENDING_APPROVAL->ACTIVE (compound) and APPROVED->ACTIVE; reject from DRAFT/PENDING_APPROVAL/APPROVED -> REJECTED. SUPERSEDED is reached through authority loss, not this table (noted in a comment beside revActivate).

Empty-row hazard found while transcribing: planning.cancel and graph.supersede have empty from-state lists but are NOT creation commands - the old "empty means GENESIS" rule would have fabricated two phantom genesis edges and a phantom race pair. Both are now declared explicitly in NEVER_LEGAL_COMMANDS beside GENESIS_COMMANDS, and step 5's gate proves the two lists exactly partition the empty rows, so a future empty row cannot slip in under either reading.

New file (structural, in-scope under packages/testkit/src/schedule/**): schedule-universe-tables.ts, 211 lines - the shared EDGE/RACE/FAULT data, the genesis/never-legal declarations, CORE_TRANSITION_TABLES (now GOAL + GRAPH_REVISION + PLANNING_RUN + PROJECT, still projected from EDGE so a schedule cannot cite an edge the table lacks), and defineSchedule. Split out because injecting two aggregates pushed the old invariants file past its target; invariants is now 117 lines and scenarios 84 (tables 211) - all far under the 400 hard bar, no amendment needed for size.

Derived universe grew exactly as intended: 21 -> 53 transitions, 18 -> 50 race pairs. Race authoring uses racesIn(aggregate, fromState, commands), which expands an AUTHOR-DECLARED concurrent command set into its unordered pairs - the checker still derives the same set independently from the injected table, so this is compact, not vacuous. Nine RUN_RACE groups plus three REVISION_RACE groups cover all 32 new pairs (the six-command PLANNING fan-in is covered by four overlapping declared subsets: lease, submission, seal, recovery).

Thirteen new schedules claim the growth, each mapped to an obligation that already owns the semantics: I1 claim uniqueness (READY claim vs cancel), I2 fencing (lease/release/recover), I3 legal lifecycle (draft readiness), I4 proof before acceptance (seal), I5 durable ordering (submission drain), I8 supersession (revision decide/reject), I12 approval binding (PLAN_REVIEW fan-in), I13 authority parity (APPROVED decisions), I17 recovery truth (MULTI), S5 rejection lineage, S9 submission drain (MULTI), S11 revision draft, S13 planning fan-in (MULTI, the design-1182 carrier). 51 -> 64 schedules, all identities still unique.

VERIFIED GOOD, do not redo: `pnpm test:property` exit 0 (2 files/40 tests); repo `pnpm test` exit 0 (78 files/1036 passed, 1 pre-existing skip); testkit typecheck exit 0 (repo typecheck fails only in untracked foreign packages/mcp).
